av_event.line_text: Honestly, you'd be surprised. Once you start looking you see them everywhere. I saw a kestrel this morning by the bus stop, just hovering over the verge.
av_event.what: In the lower right corner of Megan's frame, the fleece blanket draped over the guinea pig cage visibly shifts and bulges as the animal moves about underneath it, then settles again.
